repository: workspace-relative paths; no absolute workstation root recorded
review_method: Read-only direct content/scope inspection and SHA-256 refresh. No tests, installs, network or database commands were run. Matched values were suppressed and not copied into this artifact.

scope_review_summary.package_manifest_review: 67 package manifests in this range were compared to HEAD; all changed only top-level scripts. Script-key names are recorded per file. This review did not execute the scripts.
scope_review_summary.control_evidence_policy: Internal control/gate records are not candidate source/product content: clean records are EXCLUDE; records containing local filesystem paths remain HOLD pending redaction/provenance resolution.

sensitivity_scan.value_storage: counts and categories only; no matched email, URL, name, CPF, token, or local path literal is stored
methods: home/Users and tmp path-shape regular expressions
email and URL scheme shape expressions; database URLs also categorized for userinfo provenance
common private-key, GitHub/AWS key, JWT and bearer-token markers
CPF-shaped digits excluded when the run occurs inside a long hexadecimal digest; check digits computed without retaining candidates
person-name heuristic limited to explicit name-related keys/labels and capitalized multiword JSON string values
limitations: Heuristic scans can miss values encoded, split, obfuscated, or expressed without recognized labels; zero matches do not prove absence of personal or secret data.
Name detection covers structured name keys and explicit labels, not every natural-language name in prose.
CPF shape counts can have numeric false positives; this review records only checksummed values outside long hex digests as potentially relevant.
Source scope review is not functional testing, cryptographic verification of gate claims, or candidate approval.
The scan is bounded to the selected 126 rows and current readable file contents; it does not certify other files.

candidate_state: NO_CANDIDATE_APPROVAL; all decisions are limited to this selected review range and require a later fresh snapshot/independent review.
